inspections.title: Environmental Inspections
inspections.scanHint: Creates a notification (bell) for items that are due/overdue right now — this is not recording an inspection. The system normally sends these reminders automatically.

inspections.scanNoneBody: No additional due items — all reminders already sent.

legend.label: Status meaning:
legend.oneExceeded: One value out of range (temperature or humidity)
legend.multipleExceeded: Multiple values out of range — acknowledgement required

ack.title: Acknowledge Alert
ack.nextStep1: Investigate why the reading was out of range and the impact on stored stock (quarantine / re-test required?)
ack.nextStep2: Take corrective action (e.g. adjust temperature / request cooler repair) and record it in the notes field
ack.nextStep3: If product quality is affected, open a Deviation/CAPA under GMP Compliance to investigate and track follow-up
